probe_A_retreat_required.why: no state is retreat-only (min sampled solutions = 1) and none has zero retreat solutions; retreat works to some degree everywhere and is strictly required nowhere. 'Is a retreat required here?' has no ground truth to probe, so the label the distillation was asked to condition on is not a well-defined property of the states

B_on_top_vs_at_face.meaning: these need opposite corrections -- get off the pipe vs clear it -- so a policy that cannot tell them apart cannot correct either

D_x_position_regression.meaning: sanity floor: if features do not carry position, B and C failing says nothing

verdict: **THE FEATURES DO CARRY STATE INFORMATION: x-position out-of-fold R² 0.712, wall identity separable for 6 of 6 walls, on-top vs at-face AUC 0.651 (perm p=0.172).** So the representation is not the limit. **But probe A is not constructible: retreat is required at NO state and useful at EVERY state (share 0.047–0.952, median 0.204), so the label the distillation was asked to condition on does not exist.** That is why neither round produced conditionality, and it is a different diagnosis from either an objective problem or a capacity problem.
